issues.message: Declared readOnlyHint: true and also set destructiveHint — the spec defines destructiveHint as meaningful only when readOnlyHint is false, so this combination is self-contradictory and destructiveHint's value here has no defined meaning. Common when a new tool is cloned from an existing write-tool's annotation block and only readOnlyHint gets flipped to true.
